Sources & approach

Human development, illustrated.

Sixteen representative stages, from fertilization to pregnancy week 40. Early dates count days after fertilization; pregnancy weeks count from the last menstrual period, approximately two weeks earlier. Carnegie stages describe embryonic morphology and do not extend through the fetal period.

Original schematic geometry based on published descriptions. These are not scans, tracked cells, clinical models, or predictions from a developmental model. Anatomy, poses, colors, exploded spacing, surface folds, and transitions are illustrative. Some organs and microscopic structures are omitted. No specialist anatomical validation has been performed.

Each view is framed independently. Reference lengths are broad educational approximations, not measurements of these meshes. Crown–rump and crown–heel measurements are distinguished.
